name: getThemeColor
description: Returns the theme colour for the given key.

name: setCallbacksActive
description: This can be used to temporarily disable UI callbacks.

name: fieldWidth
description: Get's the default width for a numeric field.

name: fieldHeight
description: Gets the default height for a numeric field.

name: add
description: Adds a widget to the root layout.

name: addStretch
description: Adds a stretchable space to the root layout.

name: addSpacing
description: Adds a fixed amount of space to the root layout.

name: setSpaceBetween
description: Sets the spacing between elements in the layout.

name: setBackgroundColor
description: Sets the spacing between elements in the layout.

name: setMargins
description: Sets the margins of the root layout.

name: chooseFileToOpen
description: Returns the chosen file path, this is empty if the user presses cancel from the dialog box. The file filter string should follow the format "Palettes (*.pal *.ase *.theme)"

name: chooseFolderPath
description: Returns the chosen folder path or empty if the user presses cancel from the dialog box.

name: chooseFileToSave
description: Returns the chosen file path to create or empty if the user presses cancel from the dialog box. The file filter string should follow the format "Palettes (*.pal *.ase *.theme)"

name: addMenuItem
description: Adds a menu item to the context menu.

name: addSubMenu
description: Adds a submenu to the context menu.

name: clearContextMenu
description: Clears all items from the context menu.

name: showContextMenuOnRightClick
description: Enables showing the context menu on right-click events.

name: showContextMenu
description: Shows the context menu at the current cursor position.

name: runFileScript
description: Runs a GUI script from a file, returning true on success.

name: scriptLocation
description: Gets the folder path of the current script.

name: show
description: Shows the window.

name: size
description: Returns the size of the window.

name: setFixedSize
description: Sets a fixed size for the window.

name: setMinimumWidth
description: Sets the minimum width for the window.

name: setMinimumHeight
description: Sets the minimum height for the window.

name: setMaximumWidth
description: Sets the maximum width for the window.

name: setMaximumHeight
description: Sets the maximum height for the window.

name: setFixedWidth
description: Sets a fixed width for the window.

name: setFixedHeight
description: Sets a fixed height for the window.

name: setTitle
description: Sets the window title.

name: setToolbar
description: Marks the widget as a toolbar.

name: setVerticalToolbar
description: Sets the toolbar orientation to vertical.

name: openSceneDialog
description: Opens a file browser for opening Cavalry Scenes

name: addCallbackObject
description: Sets the callback object for the window. This can be used to trigger methods when certain app events happen.

name: registerDragDropMimeType
description: Registers a drop mime type (e.g layerIds, color, text) for the window.
